{{Quote|OOM-14 has allowed the Naboo to make off with a precious droid control program.|Nute Gunray, to OOM-9|audio=OOM-14Sucks.flac|<ref name="GB" />}}
'''OOM-14''' was an [[OOM command battle droid/Legends|OOM command]] [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]] of the [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|Trade Federation Droid Army]]. The [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] was in command of a small force and responsible for operating and guarding a [[droid control program]], a physical [[Color/Legends|brown]] cube, located near the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Harte Secur]] during the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|invasion]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]. They were defeated by the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]] of Harte Secur, and the program was lost, rendering OOM-14's forces useless and deactivated. [[Viceroy of the Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation Viceroy]] [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]] tasked [[OOM-9/Legends|OOM-9]], the command [[Droid/Legends|droid]] leading the invasion, with retrieving the program, and upon doing so, OOM-14's forces were reactivated.

==Biography==
{{Quote|One of the droid control programs has been stolen by the pitiful Naboo.|Nute Gunray|<ref name="GB" />}}
[[File:DeactivatedCamp-SWGB.png|thumb|left|300px|OOM-14's deactivated army]]
Created by [[Baktoid Combat Automata/Legends|Baktoid Combat Automata]],<ref name="Databank" /> OOM-14 was an [[OOM command battle droid/Legends|OOM command]] [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]] in the [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|Trade Federation Droid Army]]. During the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|invasion]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], the [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] was a leader in the initial landing on the world and was tasked with protecting one of five [[droid control program]]s, physical [[Color/Legends|brown]] cubes that kept the Droid Army active. However, OOM-14 was unable to protect the device, and a [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]] team called [[Force Command Two]] stole it, rendering the [[Droid/Legends|droid]]'s [[Army/Legends|army]] inoperative at a [[Deactivated Camp]]. Knowing that the program in the Naboo's hands could compromise the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation's]] invasion efforts, [[Viceroy of the Trade Federation/Legends|Federation Viceroy]] [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]] ordered [[OOM-9/Legends|OOM-9]], his personal command [[Droid/Legends|droid]], to steal back the program from the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Harte Secur]], where it was being studied by the [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]]. OOM-9 retrieved it and reactivated OOM-14's army with the help of a [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] [[Unidentified Neimoidian technician (Harte Secur)|technician]], thereafter leading a [[Capture of Harte Secur|retaliatory attack]] on Harte Secur.<ref name="GB" />

==Characteristics==
OOM-14 was a B1 battle droid<ref name="GB" /> that stood 1.91 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] (6 [[Foot/Legends|feet]], 3 inches) tall<ref name="TCWCE" /> and weighed 65 [[Kilogram/Legends|kilograms]].<ref name="TCW H2H" /> They had [[Gender/Legends|masculine programming]],<ref name="TCWCE" /> an [[E-5 blaster rifle/Legends|E-5 blaster rifle]],<ref name="Equipment" /> and a [[Backpack/Legends|backpack]] with an [[Antenna/Legends|antenna]] on a body with [[Color/Legends|light tan]] plating and brown markings.<ref name="GB" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|We have secured the city of Pontel.|OOM-14 in cut dialogue|audio=Pontel.flac|<ref name="GB" />}}
OOM-14 was first mentioned in the [[2001]] [[Wikipedia:Personal computer|PC]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]'', where the droid was voiced by [[Robert Pike Daniel]]. In the second level of the Trade Federation campaign titled "Behind the Lines," in which the player controls OOM-9's forces to retrieve the droid control program and destroy Harte Secur, OOM-14 is mentioned as the command droid responsible for the loss of the droid control program, but the droid does not make an actual appearance in the game's storyline. However, OOM-14 is included in the scenario editor mode of the game, where they are a unit that can be put in a player-made level. Unused audio files from the first level of the Trade Federation campaign, "Beachhead," portray OOM-14 spotting Naboo soldiers near the city of [[Pontel]], and proceeding to successfully attack it.<ref name="GB" />
